bead.title: Implement RecoveryReadPort for postgres
bead.description:
PROBLEM
RecoveryReadPort (explain_commit, side_record) is not implemented on postgres (empty impl inherits Unavailable), so a committed transition's side records / instance fence / per-entry outcomes cannot be recovered or audited after the fact on postgres, unlike sqlite-relational (crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs: relational_explain_commit_recovers_transition_and_survives_reopen).

PROPOSED FIX
Implement explain_commit (reconstruct a CommitRecovery from the retained request-id idempotency record plus current durable state: consumed input id, advanced instance fence, side-record keys, lifecycle item ids, per-entry status) and side_record (point read of an opaque non-work record by key) on the in-scope postgres backend(s), matching sqlite-relational's semantics.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs (and/or lib.rs per scope decision)

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- commit_transition itself (sibling bead, can run in parallel since both read the tables added in pqueue-593007ee).
bead.acceptance:
1. A live-DB test (env-gated PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL) proves explain_commit reconstructs a previously committed transition (request id, instance fence, side-record keys, lifecycle ids, per-entry status) and the record survives a reconnect.
2. A live-DB test proves side_record returns the correct opaque payload by key, and Ok(None) for an unwritten key.
3. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
